jobs.description:
Looking for a stable production job with good pay where you work with your hands? We are hiring Production Workers for the Core Making department at MGG in Tegelen. In this department, you produce sand cores that are used to make high-quality aluminum castings for industries like automotive, energy, and medical equipment. This is a hands-on job in a 3-shift system, including night shifts. This job is a good fit if you: Live near Tegelen and have your own accommodation and transport Have experience working in a 3-shift system (or at least night shifts) Speak English, German, or Dutch Experience as a Production Worker or Operator is a plus, but motivation and reliability are more important. What you get: €20.18 gross per hour including allowances (see below how it is calculated) Full-time job of 37,5 hours per week in 3 shifts Travel allowance Long-term, stable work Chance of a permanent contract in the future Opportunity to develop your technical skills How is the salary calculated? The basic hourly wage is €16.06. You receive a 120% surcharge for all hours worked, whether you work the early, late, or night shift. €16.06 x 120% = €19.27. In addition, you also receive €0.91 in ADV per hour worked: €19.27 + €0.91 = €20.18 gross per hour. As a Production Worker in the Core Making department, you will: Prepare sand mixtures used for making cores Operate machines that produce sand cores Check the quality of produced cores Report deviations or issues to your supervisor Perform basic maintenance on machines Keep your workplace clean and safe Work together with colleagues to keep production running smoothly This is active, physical work where precision is important. Perfect for people with experience as: Production worker Factory worker Metalworker Construction worker Important This job is: In a 3-shift system including night shifts (06:00–14:00 / 14:00–22:00 / 22:00–06:00) Physical production work Apply now and become part of the team at MGG in Tegelen!
